A gruelling journey across the continent awaits Shakhtar Donetsk, who will play the first of their four UEFA Champions League (UCL) ‘home’ games at Stamford Bridge when they host AEK Athens.

The Ukrainian side’s knack for keeping clean sheets in victories and AEK’s for drawing a blank in defeat point towards Shakhtar Donetsk winning to nil here.
